title: Knock, knock! 敲敲门！
description: A knock at the door turns out to be no one at all. Helen invites Jim to have lunch in the garden. The lesson covers 'anyone/anybody', 'anything/anything', 'nothing/nobody/nowhere', 'invite', 'impossible' and 'joke'.
answer_note: Workbook A (Expected answers) and B (Vocabulary) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-112-117.jpg). Grammar I-III are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.551-552).

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: I'll knock again, Helen. Everything's very quiet. I'm sure there's no one at home.
lines.translation: 我再敲一次，海伦。静悄悄的。我敢肯定家里没有人。

lines.speaker: HELEN
lines.text: But that's impossible. Carol and Tom invited us to lunch. Look through the window.
lines.translation: 但这是不可能的。卡罗尔和汤姆邀请我们来吃午饭。从窗子往里面看看。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Hello, Helen. Hello, Jim. Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden. It's nice and warm out here.
lines.translation: 你们好，海伦。你们好，吉姆。大家想坐在院子里吃午饭。这里既美丽又暖和。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Come and have something to drink, Jim.

lines.speaker: JIM
lines.text: Thanks, Carol. May I have a glass of beer, please?
lines.translation: 谢谢你，卡罗尔。请给我来一杯啤酒，好吗？

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Beer? There's none left. You can have some lemonade.
lines.translation: 啤酒？一点也没有了。你可以喝些柠檬水。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Don't believe her, Jim. She's only joking. Have some beer!
lines.translation: 别信她的，吉姆。她只是开玩笑的。请喝点啤酒吧！

items.meaning: 任何人（用于疑问句、否定式）

items.title: 1. Isn't there anyone at home? 家里没有人吗？
items.text: 在英语中，由 some, any, no, every 与 -one, -thing 组成的复合词，起代词作用，常被称为不定代词，这是因为我们常常不清楚其所指的是谁或什么。

items.title: 2. nice and ...
items.text: 用于形容词或副词前面以加强语气，一般表示褒义，但有时也用于贬义。

items.title: 3. There's none left.
items.text: 一点都没剩下。句中的 left 是个过去分词，用来修饰 none。

Yes, it is.

questions.answer: They invited them to lunch.

(She says:) Can you see anything?
No, nothing at all.

questions.answer: Yes, she does.
Let's try the back door.
Everyone (is).

questions.answer: In the garden.

Yes, she is.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Fill in the blanks with 'somewhere', 'anywhere', 'everywhere' or 'nowhere'
grammar.instruction: 用 somewhere, anywhere, everywhere 或 nowhere 填空。
grammar.translation: 用 somewhere, anywhere, everywhere 或 nowhere 填空。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.552 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: Dialogue about looking for a lost watch; 8 blanks.

questions.prompt: Yes, I'm looking for my watch. I left it ___ this morning.
questions.answer: somewhere

questions.prompt: I looked ___ in my office, but I couldn't find it ___.
questions.answer: everywhere

questions.prompt: I looked everywhere in my office, but I couldn't find it ___.
questions.answer: anywhere

questions.prompt: Can it be ___ in your room?
questions.answer: anywhere

questions.prompt: I'm sure it must be ___ in my room, and I've looked ___ in the room for an hour...
questions.answer: somewhere

questions.prompt: I've looked somewhere in the room for an hour, but still I can't find it ___.
questions.answer: everywhere

questions.prompt: I've looked everywhere in the room for an hour, but still I can't find it ___.
questions.answer: anywhere

questions.prompt: It isn't in my office and it isn't in my room. It's ___! I've lost it!
questions.answer: nowhere

l115-scene.description: Seven panels: Jim knocking at the door, Jim and Helen talking at the front door, Jim looking through the window, Jim and Helen at the back door, everyone in the garden, Carol offering Jim something to drink, and Jim drinking lemonade/beer.
